description: English Wikipedia pages for Second Punic War reference notes. Keep this list at battle, siege, crossing, or campaign scale.

pages.title: Second Punic War
pages.note: Broad context only. Use specific battles, sieges, crossings, and campaigns for tactical extraction.

pages.title: Siege of Saguntum
pages.note: Provocation, siege pressure, Roman alliance politics, and escalation to wider war.

pages.title: Hannibal's crossing of the Alps
pages.note: Operational surprise, mountain passage, attrition, and psychological shock.

pages.title: Battle of the Trebia
pages.note: Ambush, weather, river crossing fatigue, and concealed reserve attack.

pages.title: Battle of Lake Trasimene
pages.note: March-column ambush, terrain trap, fog or visibility, and command disruption.

pages.title: Battle of Cannae
pages.note: Double envelopment, elastic center, cavalry superiority, and mass encirclement.

pages.title: Battle of the Metaurus
pages.note: Interception of reinforcement, forced march, and defeat of Hasdrubal before junction with Hannibal.

pages.title: Battle of Baecula
pages.note: Hill position, flanking attack, and Scipio's pressure on Carthaginian forces in Iberia.

pages.title: Battle of Ilipa
pages.note: Deceptive deployment, timing reversal, and infantry-cavalry coordination.

pages.title: Battle of Zama
pages.note: Anti-elephant lanes, cavalry return, veteran infantry, and final reversal of Hannibal's methods.
